english.title: Fail to comply with notice to remove a tree / shrub planted
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[occupier]_

of land in which a

(C)_[tree]_
(D)_[shrub]_

was planted, failed to comply with a notice under section141(2) of the Highways Act 1980 requiring you to remove it within 21 days from the date of service of the notice
english.legislation: Contrary to section 141(3) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.standardstatementoffacts:

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[occupier]_

of land in which a

(C)_[tree]_

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 1 on the standard scale and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of 50p for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
